project_info.theme: Cold teal-green city portrait with windblown hair
project_info.color_palette: teal green, dark charcoal, warm amber bokeh, muted gray

main_subject.detail: An adult woman stands outdoors at night wearing a dark elegant coat and a thick wool scarf wrapped around her neck. Loose hair strands are gently blown by the wind around her face; she has natural skin texture, subtle makeup, and a calm introspective expression.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: gentle cinematic illumination and diffused bokeh against a cool teal-green environment

technical_specs.color_treatment: moody teal-green grade, film-like softness, natural skin texture, controlled bokeh

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic nighttime portrait of an adult woman standing outdoors, softly lit by ambient city lights. She wears a dark elegant coat with a thick wool scarf wrapped around her neck. Loose strands of hair gently blown by the wind frame her face. Give her a calm introspective expression, natural skin texture, and subtle makeup. Use moody teal-green color grading, soft cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, and creamy bokeh city lights glowing in the background. Render with film-like softness, an atmospheric emotional tone, an 85mm f/1.4 look, ultra-realistic photography, high detail, low noise, and vertical 8K quality.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: If supplied, use an approved adult face reference and preserve its facial structure, proportions, features, and expression. Preserve the dark coat, wool scarf, windblown hair, teal-green lighting, and creamy city bokeh. Do not use celebrity/public-figure likeness.

assets.name: approved-adult-face-reference
assets.usage: Maintain adult face, facial structure, proportions, features, and expression.

changes: Clarified the subject as an adult while preserving the original dark coat, scarf, city bokeh, teal-green grading, and emotional night mood.
